question: For what use is sacrifice first described, and wherein is initiation itself the means?
premises: now for this use, sacrifice is described first
therein initiation itself attains means-ness in enjoyment and in liberation
inference: Yaga-description opens the work; initiation itself is the means to both enjoyment and liberation.
uncertainties: upayoga (use) scope kept general per opening formula
plain_english: Now for this use sacrifice first is described — therein initiation itself attains means-ness in enjoyment and in liberation.
